<function name="SetViewPunchAngles" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Sets client's view punch angle, but not the velocity. See <page>Player:ViewPunch</page></description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="punchAngle" type="Angle">The angle to set.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
